units.source_text: 每次看到这封少女气息慢慢的信，信子都会不由的流泪。

en.t: Every time Nobuko saw this letter, so full of a young girl's feeling, she could not help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 尤其是想到照子在中央车站前偷偷塞给自己这封信时的样子，信子就会更加心痛。

en.t: Especially when she thought of how Teruko had secretly thrust the letter into her hands in front of Central Station, Nobuko's heart ached all the more.

units.source_text: 但是她如今的婚姻，难道真的像妹妹所说的那样是彻底的牺牲吗？

en.t: But was her present marriage really, as her younger sister said, a complete sacrifice?

units.source_text: 这个怀疑让她哭过之后的心情更加消沉，

en.t: This doubt made her mood after crying sink even lower,

units.source_text: 为了不沉浸在这种消沉中，信子一般会让自己沉浸在欢乐的感伤中，眺望松林的绝美风景——阳光洒在松林中，从朝阳到夕暮。

en.t: To keep from sinking into that dejection, Nobuko would usually immerse herself in a cheerful melancholy and gaze at the exquisite scenery of the pine grove, where sunlight poured through the trees from morning until dusk.
